caveats: Best fit for outreach in this batch: Pro-Tec Systems (operating since 1988, commercial fire/security, broken SSL, compromised site, unclaimed Google profile). 1844CarKeyz and All Purpose Maintenance are quick wins but small budgets. AFA Protective Systems is now part of the national Pavion group and is a poor fit for a one-person consultancy.

Six of ten entries are locksmiths or security installers with no findable website, and four have no verifiable web presence at all. North Brunswick's Google Maps results for 'locksmith' are dominated by listings at shared or residential addresses with out-of-state phone numbers (for example a 'Bartlett St' listing with a Vermont area code), a pattern typical of lead-generation listings, so treat any locksmith directory entry in this batch as unverified.

Google Maps was only usable in the limited (signed-out, compressed) view here: place pages showed the star rating but not always the review count, so review counts are reported as 'not shown' rather than guessed.

AFA Protective Systems is not a franchise or a small local shop; it is a Pavion-owned regional contractor. It was kept in the batch and scored honestly rather than excluded, since it is a real operating business at the address.
Inferences are labelled in the field text; nothing was quoted at length and no review text is reproduced beyond a few words.
data_gaps: protecsystems.net could not be rendered in the browser (Chrome refused it with a certificate name mismatch and HTTP was blocked), so mobile layout and the visual first screen were judged from the raw HTML - no viewport meta tag, FrontPage 5.0 table layout - rather than from a phone screenshot.

AFA Protective Systems' Google review count and claim status could not be read in the limited Maps view; the request-service page returned no form fields to inspection (likely JS-rendered), so only the presence of reCAPTCHA and the page copy were confirmed. The form was not submitted.

No listing, phone verification or owner confirmation was obtained for Accurate International Tech, Aiko Consulting, Pro Service Locksmith, All-Star Locksmiths or AA NSW Locksmiths; status 'not found' means no verifiable web presence, not a confirmed closure.
Middlesex County's hauler document for All Purpose Maintenance is dated 2022, so current operation is inferred rather than confirmed.
YellowPages pages returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches, so some address and category details come from search-result summaries of those pages rather than from reading them directly.
